name: Filter resolved comments

name: Filter comments by author

name: Annotation text

name: Annotation category

name: Annotation categories management

name: Measurement annotation

name: Distance annotation

name: Developer note

name: Alias chain inspection
notes: Named iterative alias traces include collection/mode/fallback, missing/cycle labels and visible 256-hop guard. See docs/DEV-INSPECTION.md.

name: Download selected asset
notes: Partial: read-only Inspect downloads of the chosen layer/subtree using real SVG/PNG/JPG or existing saved export profiles; locked artwork, multi-selection source, guarded preparation/cancellation and native handoff. Base artwork requires Motion closed; cloud/plugin assets and complete Dev Mode/native reference acceptance remain outside this path. See docs/INSPECT-ASSET-DOWNLOAD.md.

name: Ready-for-development status
notes: Inspect marks page or one unlocked non-managed layer ready for development, with badges/search, component defaults and explicit instance-root overrides/reset. Legacy section Ready flags remain compatible. One Undo/save/reopen; no cloud assignment or completion verification. See docs/LOCAL-HANDOFF-STATUS.md.

name: Completed development status
notes: Inspect marks page or unlocked editable layer completed, resets to no status, filters completed layers and keeps source/instance override semantics. Validation, context/Motion guards, Undo/save/reopen apply. Local authored status, not verified code completion. See docs/LOCAL-HANDOFF-STATUS.md.

name: Handoff section list
notes: Inspect handoff list searches ready/completed pages, sections and layers across the file; status/scope filters, bounded indexing, 50-row pagination and actual page/layer navigation preserve hidden/locked artwork. No hosted developer workspace. See docs/LOCAL-HANDOFF-STATUS.md.

name: Handoff annotation display
notes: Inspect shows actual file-local handoff annotation text, kinds/categories and live supported values across pages, with search/type filtering, bounded results and source-safe navigation to hidden/locked owners. Source references and private metadata survive .oui; no hosted annotation backend. See docs/LOCAL-LAYER-ANNOTATIONS.md.

name: Developer links
notes: Inspect → Developer resources attaches named file-local HTTP(S) links; explicit isolated open/copy, no automatic requests. Validated metadata, real Undo/save/reopen, locks and stale-context guards. Resource sites retain their own permissions. See docs/DEVELOPER-RESOURCES.md.

name: Attach issue link
notes: Inspect → Developer resources → Issue accepts a named validated HTTP(S) issue URL, editable/removable/copyable with Undo/save/reopen. File-local attachment only; no issue-account authentication or status synchronization. See docs/DEVELOPER-RESOURCES.md.

name: Attach documentation link
notes: Inspect → Developer resources → Documentation attaches a named validated HTTP(S) documentation URL with explicit open/copy, editing/removal, Undo and persistence. No remote content embedding or automatic fetch. See docs/DEVELOPER-RESOURCES.md.

name: Attach repository link
notes: Inspect → Developer resources → Repository attaches a named validated HTTP(S) repository URL with explicit open/copy, editing/removal, Undo and persistence. No repository discovery, account access or code mapping. See docs/DEVELOPER-RESOURCES.md.

name: Inspect variant properties
notes: Read-only component-set variant values/description and nearest nested-instance main context. See docs/DEV-INSPECTION.md.

name: Inspect instance overrides
notes: Explicit root/descendant override values compared with source and component-property defaults; 2000-row budget, 200-row pages, redacted embedded assets and 1MB copy refusal. See docs/DEV-INSPECTION.md.

name: Dev resource management
notes: Inspect manages bounded resource lists (32/layer, 4,096/document): strict URL/shape validation, attach/edit/remove/open/copy, locks, context cancellation, component defaults/overrides/reset, library-update propagation, Undo/save/reopen and reports. Bridge explicitly omits links without flattening resource-only instance overrides; no Dev Resources API/hosted synchronization claim. See docs/DEVELOPER-RESOURCES.md.
